title: get_health_endpoint_returns_service_status
description: Verify that GET /api/health returns a 200 status code with a JSON body containing {ok: true} when the service is healthy.

title: post_runs_starts_pipeline_run
description: Test POST /api/runs with valid body parameters to start a new pipeline run and verify the response contains the created run record with status and metadata.

title: get_runs_list_recent_runs
description: Verify GET /api/runs returns a 200 status code with an array of recent runs ordered from newest to oldest.

title: get_runs_runid_stream_returns_sse_events
description: Test GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream returns a 200 status with text/event-stream content type streaming pipeline progress events.

title: post_runs_runid_stop_cancels_active_run
description: Verify POST /api/runs/{run_id}/stop cancels an active run and returns 200 with updated run record; returns 404 if run is missing and 409 if run is not active.

title: get_applications_filters_and_retrieves_applications
description: Test GET /api/applications with optional run_id and status filters returns 200 with matching application array.

title: patch_applications_runid_updates_application
description: Verify PATCH /api/applications/{app_id} updates application fields like status, notes, tags, and deadline; returns 422 on invalid status and 404 if application is missing.

title: post_ranked_rankedid_generate_rescues_job
description: Test POST /api/ranked/{ranked_id}/generate rescues a non-selected job by generating an application; returns 200 with new run_id, 404 if ranked job missing, 409 if already generated, and 400 if no stored description.

title: post_inbox_sync_updates_application_statuses
description: Verify POST /api/inbox/sync with valid Gmail credentials scans inbox and updates application statuses; returns 400 if inbox credentials are missing.

title: get_reminders_digest_preview_returns_digest_content
description: Test GET /api/reminders/digest/preview returns 200 with digest subject, html, text, and empty flag without sending an email.
